Its solutions combine hardware, software, and AI-driven technologies to support complex, large-scale operations. Airobotics works primarily with defense industries, such as military and law enforcement agencies worldwide. The company is part of Ondas Holdings and operates as a wholly owned subsidiary. We are looking for an Electronics Quality Inspector to perform incoming inspection of components, electronic boards, assemblies, and harnesses received from suppliers and subcontractors, in accordance with drawings, specifications, standards, and the company’s quality requirements. The role includes identifying deviations, documenting findings, opening non-conformities, and working closely with Engineering, Procurement, Warehouse, and Production departments. Responsibilities Perform incoming inspection of electronic components, PCB/PCBA boards, harnesses, electro-mechanical assemblies, and raw materials. Verify compliance with purchase orders, part numbers, delivery notes, CoC, test reports, and manufacturer documentation. Conduct visual inspections of electronic boards according to IPC requirements, including soldering quality, missing or reversed components, mechanical damage, component markings, and cleanliness. Verify the compliance of boards and assemblies with drawings, BOMs, manufacturing specifications, and product files. Use basic measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, multimeters, continuity testers, and other tools as needed. Document inspection results in quality/ERP systems and prepare incoming inspection reports. Open and document non-conformities, including NCR/MRB processes, with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Work with Engineering, Production, Procurement, and Warehouse teams to handle deviations and release items to production. Maintain traceability of components and products, including batch numbers, serial numbers, and related documentation. Participate in quality improvement processes with suppliers and subcontractors. Requirements Electronics Technician or Practical Electronics Engineer. 2-4 years of previous experience in quality inspection in the electronics industry / electronics manufacturing / incoming inspection. Ability to read drawings, BOMs, technical specifications, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Familiarity with inspection of electronic components, electronic boards, and harnesses. Proficiency in using basic measuring tools. Organized work style, high accuracy, strong attention to detail, and high-level documentation and reporting skills. Technical English proficiency for reading documents, specifications, and supplier certificates. Significant Advantage: Certification or familiarity with IPC standards, such as IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620, or J-STD-001. Experience working with ERP systems / Priority / Arena / Agile / SAP. Required Personal Skills: High level of personal responsibility, orderliness, organization, and ability to work according to procedures. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Strong interpersonal communication skills with multiple interfaces. Ability to identify problems, escalate deviations, and maintain uncompromising quality with a proactive approach. Its solutions combine hardware, software, and AI-driven technologies to support complex, large-scale operations. Airobotics works primarily with defense industries, such as military and law enforcement agencies worldwide. The company is part of Ondas Holdings and operates as a wholly owned subsidiary. We are seeking an Associate Program Manager to support the execution of complex, multidisciplinary programs in autonomous aerial systems and counter-drone technologies. Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this role combines hands-on project coordination with direct ownership of defined workstreams and cross-functional deliverables from initiation to completion. This is an exceptional opportunity for a proactive, high-potential individual to manage high-tempo project execution, remove operational bottlenecks, and drive cross-functional delivery under demanding schedules. Prior project management experience is not required: strong candidates may come from technical, operational, integration, supply chain, procurement, or support backgrounds and be ready to step into program management under experienced guidance. Responsibilities ﻿Program Execution & Support: Report to the Program Manager and support day-to-day execution, planning, and cross-functional coordination across R&D, operations, procurement, supply chain, and finance. Workstream Ownership: Own defined project tasks end-to-end—defining objectives, building execution plans, tracking dependencies, and driving deliverables to completion. Procurement Oversight: Drive project procurement requirements, coordinating closely with supply chain and purchasing teams to track orders, supplier commitments, and long-lead items. Integration & Delivery Readiness: Ensure total hardware and equipment readiness for all key milestones, proactively identifying missing components and resolving supply gaps ahead of integration, testing, and field deployments. System Rollout & Client Focal Point: Lead end-to-end system implementation with operational end-users, serving as the main point of contact; coordinate and guide internal teams to provide rapid support and resolve technical and field issues. Task & Action Item Management: Maintain action-item trackers and project task boards; actively follow up with owners to verify progress and unblock overdue activities. Risk & Bottleneck Identification: Identify execution gaps early, analyze root causes, propose practical recovery plans, and escalate risks to the Program Manager with actionable solutions. Meeting Facilitation & Alignment: Lead focused cross-functional working sessions, align teams on decisions and next steps, and ensure clear ownership and deadlines. Field & Event Support: Assist in preparing for and executing formal program reviews, integration activities, field trials, demonstrations, and customer deliveries. Documentation & Tools: Provide concise status updates and decision-support materials. Requirements Ownership & Execution: Strong personal drive, initiative, and attention to detail—ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follow through diligently to successful completion. Matrix Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, coordinate multiple contributors, and help build team accountability. Problem-Solving Orientation: Proactive and practical mindset; work with teams to execute practical solutions. Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication skills in both Hebrew and English; confident interacting with technical, operational, and business stakeholders. Learning Agility: High curiosity and eagerness to quickly dive into and master unfamiliar details. Technical Adaptability: Strong ability to quickly learn and navigate new software, systems, and program management tools. Dedication & Flexibility: Strong commitment and hands-on approach; willing to flex schedule when needed to support critical program milestones, field trials, and client demonstrations. UAS & Defence Technologies: Familiarity with unmanned aerial systems (UAS/drones), counter-drone technologies, robotics, or tactical systems. This role combines technical leadership and people management, with strong ownership over architecture, execution, and alignment with the broader system (core backend and edge platforms).

jobs.title: IT Solution Architect
jobs.description: We are building a next-generation autonomous systems platform deployed across cloud and air-gapped environments, supporting real-time operations and complex hardware-software integration.The IT Solution Architect plays a key role in bridging R&D and real-world operations. This position is responsible for ensuring that our systems are successfully deployed, installed, and operational in customer environments.This is not a traditional IT role—it's a hands-on engineering position focused on system delivery, networking, and field readiness of advanced software platforms.

jobs.title: Prototyping & Flight Test Specialist
jobs.description: Airobotics develops and manufactures advanced autonomous drone systems that combine hardware, software, airborne systems, and ground systems.We are looking for a capable Prototyping & Flight Test Specialist to join our Early Development Team.This team is responsible for rapidly developing proof of concept solutions and first generation prototypes for new technologies, products, and operational capabilities. The role combines hands-on assembly, system integration, platform configuration, flight testing, and troubleshooting in a fast paced development environment.

jobs.title: Senior Edge Navigation Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are building a next-generation autonomous aerial platform, combining edge computing, real-time control, and advanced mission management across complex operational environments.The Senior Edge Navigation Software Engineer will play a key role in designing and developing the platform's navigation and state estimation software—a core capability that enables the drone to accurately understand its position, orientation, and motion in complex and dynamic environments.This role requires deep expertise in navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, perception, and real-time software development, with the opportunity to influence the architecture and implementation of advanced navigation capabilities for autonomous UAVs.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Edge
jobs.description: Airobotics is building the next generation of autonomous drone systems, enabling scalable aerial operations for industrial, security, and critical infrastructure environments.We are establishing a new Edge Applications team within our Software R&D department, focused on developing high-performance applications that run directly on drone and edge computing platforms. These applications bridge real-world robotics, autonomy, AI, and mission-critical operational workflows.As a Software Developer on the team, you will design and build software components that operate close to the hardware and real-time systems powering autonomous drones. You will work across embedded edge environments, communication systems, AI pipelines, mission logic and operational tooling.This is a hands-on engineering role with strong impact on product architecture, system capabilities and future platform evolutionWhat We OfferOpportunity to shape a new strategic engineering team from the ground upWork on cutting-edge autonomous aerial systems deployed in real-world operational environmentsHigh ownership, technical challenges, and direct impact on product directionCollaborative and multidisciplinary engineering cultureDynamic startup environment with advanced technological challenges

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Autonomous Command & Control Platform
jobs.description: We are building the core infrastructure and operating system for autonomous platforms.Our platform enables real-world autonomous operations by coordinating drones, docking stations, edge systems, operators, and external systems in real time. It serves as the operational backbone for mission execution, command and control, communication, telemetry, orchestration, and fleet coordination across distributed autonomous environments.This is not a typical backend role.You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, Command & Control (C2), autonomous platforms, and real-world operations.We are looking for engineers who are comfortable entering complex and unfamiliar systems, quickly understanding how they work, and turning operational concepts into clean software models and architectures.You should enjoy reasoning about entities, relationships, state, events, commands, missions, resources, and system boundaries — and designing software that represents and coordinates them reliably.The platform includes:Command & Control capabilities for autonomous systemsFleet orchestration and mission lifecycle managementReal-time communication between distributed autonomous componentsModeling and management of operational entities, states, and relationshipsTelemetry, video, and operational data processingDevice interoperability across heterogeneous autonomous platformsSDKs and APIs for platform integration and extensibilityAI agents and intelligent automation interacting with operational systemsAs a Senior Engineer, you will help shape the technical foundation and domain architecture of the platform while solving complex problems across distributed systems, autonomous operations, and Command & Control.

jobs.title: UAS System Engineer – ArduPilot & Flight Control
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced UAS System Engineer to join our airborne systems engineering team and serve as a key technical authority for ArduPilot-based unmanned aircraft systems, including multirotor and fixed-wing platforms.The role requires a strong system-engineering background combined with deep, hands-on expertise in ArduPilot, flight control, aircraft sensors, avionics, and system integration.The engineer will support the airborne system engineering team across aircraft development, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and flight operations, and will work closely with software, avionics, control, mechanical, and flight-test teams.A key aspect of the role is the ability to bridge aircraft behavior, flight-control logic, ArduPilot configuration, and software implementation.The ideal candidate is not only an ArduPilot user, but a system engineer who understands why the aircraft behaves the way it does and can connect aircraft-level behavior to the underlying system architecture.The candidate should be capable of moving seamlessly between:Aircraft Dynamics → Sensors → ArduPilot → Flight Control → Parameters → Logs → Software → Flight Behaviorand be able to identify, analyze, and resolve system-level issues across these domains.
